name: THE TENTS
note: EXTRACTED by tools/extract-examine.mjs from the documents its sources name -- errata 67's merge, in doc 05's, the batch's, then the repeats' order, less errata 68 H's drops. Do not edit: change the documents and re-run.

subjects.name: THE COOK FIRE
LOOK_AT: A cook fire with a kettle on it and somebody's dinner in a pan. Nobody's watching it. Everybody's watching me.
Beans, with something better than beans in them. They eat well here. They can afford to.
I'm not going to steal a man's dinner. I've thought it through, and I'm not.
LISTEN_TO: Beans, ticking in the pan.
The kettle working up to something.
Fat spitting. The best sound in two days.

overrides.USE: I warmed my hands at it. Nobody stopped me. It's the friendliest thing in camp.

subjects.name: THE WASHING LINE
LOOK_AT: Shirts on a line between two tents. Every one has a padlock on the pocket.
Good shirts, too. Store-bought. Washed by somebody else, I'd bet.
One shirt has a padlock and no buttons. A man has his priorities.
LISTEN_TO: Shirts flapping.
A padlock knocking against a peg.
Washing, drying, with nothing to add.

overrides.OPEN: Every pocket's padlocked. I tried one, to see. A man across the way stood up.

subjects.name: THE CABINS
LOOK_AT: Log cabins with chimneys of sticks and mud. The doors have more bolts than the walls have logs.
One cabin has three locks and no window. Whoever's inside has done well.
I knocked on one, to be friendly. A bolt went across inside. Then a second.
LISTEN_TO: A bolt sliding home.
Inside one, a man counting under his breath.
Counting again. He's lost his place and started over.

overrides.OPEN: I tried a latch. Three bolts answered from inside, one after another, like a choir.

subjects.name: THE TENTS
LOOK_AT: Canvas tents, every one pegged down twice and guyed like a ship.
One tent has a sign on it: KNOCK. You can't knock on a tent. That's the idea.
In Consolation the tents are full of hope. These are full of gold, and it's made them twitchy.
LISTEN_TO: Canvas breathing in the wind.
Behind one flap, coins being stacked, carefully.
Somebody snoring lightly, like a man ready to wake.

overrides.OPEN: I lifted a flap. Somebody inside said 'No', very calmly, and I put it down.

subjects.name: THE NOTICE
LOOK_AT: A notice nailed to a stump: CLAIM JUMPERS WILL BE SPOKEN TO. Underlined twice.
Underneath, in another hand: FIRMLY.
It's the most threatening thing I've read since Mr. Sump's forms.
LISTEN_TO: A nail working loose.
The notice flapping at one corner.
Quiet. It's said its piece, firmly.

overrides.PULL: Taking down a notice against strangers would make me the stranger it means.
overrides.TALK_TO: I told it I wasn't a jumper. It went on saying FIRMLY.

subjects.name: THE PATH UP
LOOK_AT: The path back up the ravine to the ledge and the mine.
Up there is the way home, eventually, and a mule.
The rope's worn bright on the bends, where everybody holds on hardest.
LISTEN_TO: Grit coming down the path.
Wind on the ledge, high up.
The rope creaking, high up.

subjects.name: THE GROG TENT
LOOK_AT: A big tent with the flap tied back and a sign: GROG. The only word anybody bothered to paint.
Men go in looking worried and come out poorer and less worried.
A man came out, looked at the sky, and went back in. It's that kind of tent.
LISTEN_TO: Glasses, low talk, and a man laughing a little too long.
A plank creaking under somebody's elbows.
A cork, and somebody laughing at nothing.

subjects.name: THE RIVER
LOOK_AT: Down to the river, where the men are standing in it.
The bank's churned to mud by a hundred pairs of rich boots.
From here every man in the river looks as if he's dropped something small.
LISTEN_TO: Water over stones, and shovels.
Shovels, and a rocker, down the bank.
The rocker, and the river, going about their business.

THE LOOKOUT.PICK_UP: I'm not going to lift a man who already thinks I'm here to take things.
THE LOOKOUT.PUSH: I gave him a friendly nudge. He raised the pan an inch, and I took my hand back.
THE LOOKOUT.USE: He's already in use. He's guarding a path, and he's doing it with his whole body.
